planSteps.description: Verify the page shows 'Hacer un pedido' as the main heading
Click on 'Domicilio normal' option in step 0
Click on the origin barrio search input and type 'Centro'
Select the first 'Centro' option from the dropdown
Click on the destination barrio search input and type 'Norte'
Select the first option with 'Norte' in the name from the dropdown
Enter 'Calle 10 # 15-20' in the origin direction field
Enter 'Carrera 15 # 20-30' in the destination direction field
Enter '150000' in the transferencia monto field
Scroll down to see the price summary section
The page should display text 'Tarifa base' indicating the price summary section is visible
The page should display text 'Total estimado' indicating the total section is visible
The total amount shown next to 'Total estimado' should be a number greater than zero
